description: Compute VMA (Maximal Aerobic Speed) from a fitness test result. Use for runners building training plans. Inputs: test type (Cooper 12-min, Luc Léger), result. Returns VMA km/h and zones. See list_bundles for related 'sport' calculators.

result_value.description: Distance in meters (cooper/demi_cooper) or final speed in km/h (vameval)

test.description: Test type: cooper (12min run), demi_cooper (6min run), vameval (final speed km/h)

name: calculate_vma

formula.description: Human-readable formula or method used (e.g. "I=P·r·t", "Magnus formula").

reference_url.description: Link to a calcul2 page documenting the calculation in detail.

result.description: Computed result. Object whose fields depend on the tool (e.g. {tax, marginal_rate, brackets} for tax tools, {volume_l, gallons} for volume tools).

source.description: Authoritative source for the rule or formula (e.g. "Article 197 CGI", "NF DTU 21").

title: Calculate Vma
